QF.id: VB Fund Distribution and Channel Management_5

question.text: Which organization issues the ARN (AMFI Registration Number) to mutual fund distributors?

answer.text: AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India)
SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India)

explanation.text: The Logic: AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India) is the industry association of SEBI-registered mutual funds that registers mutual fund distributors and allots the ARN once they clear the required NISM certification. The Trap: SEBI is the regulator of mutual funds, while AMFI is the industry association that handles distributor registration and ARN allotment. RBI and NSE play no role in issuing the ARN. Note: NISM conducts the certification examination and AMFI allots the ARN after successful certification and registration.
